description: Prose for the peaks, valleys and drops of an engagement curve. Text only: every figure in the report is filled in by the server.

id.description: The moment id copied exactly as supplied, e.g. peak-1

title.description: 3-7 words naming what is on screen at this moment

explanation.description: 2-3 sentences grounded only in the moment's supplied context; says so when the context is too thin

drivers.description: Up to 4 short content elements taken from the context; empty when the context is thin
